candidate_rule: two non-promoted candidates per record: verified official fact or deterministic rounded-snapshot comparative metric, plus explicit scope guard

scope_guards.monthly_snapshot: The June and July 2026 BDUK values are rounded management-information figures limited to initial contract scope, with variable ingestion lag; they do not establish exact-address completion, current availability, orderability or contractual milestone compliance.
scope_guards.comparative_metric: Ranks, shares, gaps, movements and contributions are deterministic calculations over displayed rounded tables and totals. They are not official statistics, parcel backlogs, forecasts or exact-address delivery claims.
scope_guards.relay_scope: Text-relay guidance describes regulated accessibility features and general use. Actual compatibility, charges, allowances and service operation depend on the provider, package, device and connection.
scope_guards.emergency_scope: Emergency-video-relay guidance describes UK 999BSL access and general service operation; it does not guarantee connectivity from a particular device, network or location.
scope_guards.emergency_rules_scope: The regulatory summary describes provider obligations and service criteria. It is not legal advice and does not establish compliance or entitlement in an individual case.
